title: Collect the change to .swarm as a diff
run:
set -uo pipefail
cd {{run_folder}}
rm -rf swarm-after swarm-base
cp -a {{project}}/.swarm swarm-after
cp -a swarm-before swarm-base
(cd swarm-after && find . -type f | sed 's|^\./||') | while read -r f; do
  if [ ! -e "swarm-base/$f" ] && {{swarm}} get -project {{project}} -below "$f" > /dev/null 2>&1; then
    mkdir -p "swarm-base/$(dirname "$f")"
    {{swarm}} get -project {{project}} -below "$f" > "swarm-base/$f" 2>/dev/null
  fi
done
diff -ruN swarm-base swarm-after > swarm-change.diff
status=$?
[ "$status" -le 1 ] || exit "$status"
echo "$(grep -c '^+++ ' swarm-change.diff) file(s) changed; a new project copy is compared with the shared one it overrides"
